title: Thai Eggplant Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and healthy Thai-inspired eggplant dish with a mix of savory and sweet notes, served with a side of Italian pasta.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions and set aside.
Cut eggplant into bite-sized pieces and set aside.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add eggplant and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add rich (fish sauce) and italian (basil) to the skillet and stir to combine.
Serve eggplant mixture over cooked pasta and enjoy!
Optional: Garnish with additional italian (basil) for added flavor.
